reviews.author: Earl “TOBIG4U” Leach
reviews.text: My always go to alignment place. I came on Friday before a holiday. I didnt know they was closing early. The owner is such a good guy and great business person did not turn me away. He took care of me quickly. One of his guy who was professional and fast got me on the road quickly as possible. Love the way they line up vehicles. Old school way is the best way.

reviews.author: Ray N
reviews.text: This is the only place to go for alignments for me. Not many shop want to work on your truck once you lift up but this place knows how to do it very well because they do the lift up job here as well. Made an appointment in the morning, I was lucky to have opening same morning, and in and out in an hour. Very fair price. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Yulun Wang
reviews.text: Booked a waiting appointment for an alignment and after about 40 minutes, my SUV drove straight again. They even test drove before and after the alignment to make sure the work was done satisfactorily, which is a rare practice these days. While waiting, I saw they not only work on sedans/crossovers, but body on frame SUVs/pick up trucks, school bus, heavy duty work trucks, and even a late 90’s - early 2000’s Toyota Land Cruiser, which speak volume about their expertise and decades of experience. After the alignment, Bryan (the owner) handed me an alignment spec sheet and also explained to me what they found and did to fix the issue. Thanks Bryan and your team for your great work. You just earned another repeating customer!

reviews.author: Joseph “Joey” Angelotti
reviews.text: Brian went out of his way to cure front strut issues on our 1999 Lumina that another shop contributed to. Never once made us feel that he would not find the solution. Beyond highly recommended! Superior work & beyond superior support of work! Many thanks! Joe & Denise

reviews.author: Michael Gaudet
reviews.text: Great service, nice people, but they charged me a fee on my debit card, which is illegal! i hope they review their policy on this.

reviews.author: Joshua Aaron
reviews.text: Support this awesome local business!! HIGHEST quality work and friendly customer service. Bryan and his team are true professionals. My 2006 vehicle brakes and corners like it's brand new. I was given options on parts and services and they actually talked me out of the expensive upgrades I thought I needed/wanted. I won't go anywhere else! Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Ahmed E
reviews.text: Brought my lowered G37 here for an alignment. No hassle or issue getting on the rack. The tech drives the car before, several times during and after the alignment process to ensure their work is done right. Best alignment I’ve had done in some time.

reviews.author: Daryl Johnson
reviews.text: My truck had 2 broken leaf springs, and the stealership wanted $2100.00 to fix it. I went to Hackensack Spring for a 2nd opinion. I am glad I did. They replaced / repaired the broken springs, and I was back in my truck the same day, for about 1/3 of what the stealership wanted. My trucks ride is so much better now, no more shimmies and clunking. I will be returning for any suspension/alignment related repairs, and recommending Hackensack Spring to friends and family. Thanks! *** UPDATE *** I recently purchased a modest lift kit / suspension upgrade for my truck (leaf springs / coils/ Bilstein 5100s), and needed a local shop to perform the install work, so Hackensack spring got the job. They did a great job, and the truck rides awesome. Work was reasonably priced, and completed in a timely manner. Still highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jay
reviews.text: Paid for a four wheel alignment and they didn’t even make any adjustments I had everything marked and everything was still In the same spot plus no print out even though I asked for one before hand the only reason you would not be given a print out would be that they didn’t even put the car on the Machine what a waste of 170 now need to find another shop anyone know of one used Wilson’s undercover for years till he retired this year now stuck so need to find a new Alignment shop Hackensack Auto Spring & Wheel Alignment (Owner) 3 hours ago Hello Jay, sorry to hear that you’re so upset about the procedure of our alignment business. Unfortunately, we can’t always produce a printout as we only have one laser machine, but we still have the old-fashioned machine that works just as well. We actually always test the calibration with our brand new machine to confirm that the old machine still works. we 1000% did your alignment, I would not be in business for 60 year If we were faking wheel alignments every day, that is not how I run my shop. You’re dealing with a family owned business that has quite the reputation. While we might seem a little unorthodox by today’s standards, we are very professional in what we do. sorry that you were experience was not as expected So I guess my paint marks on the tie rods and cam bolts are lying to me and i paid for a four wheel alignment not a toe and go on a 1940 alignment rack

reviews.author: Tom A
reviews.text: One word to describe the place is "HONEST". Good Honest People. I brought my car for a wheel alignment & brake fluid flush. The Young Lady on the phone is very knowledgeable & patient. The employees that called me are Great, Patient & Honest. Even though I had to be quick on the phone cause I had a line of people to help.

reviews.author: Dan Taylor
reviews.text: Came in with the intent for fixing my wheel alignment, but they discovered more then just that and sat with me and explained everything in detail so that I understood what was going on. Staff all around was so polite, welcoming and understanding, truly remarkable and helped me weight my options on how to continue and figure my next steps. Amazing place and amazing people

reviews.author: Dom Leuci
reviews.text: Great shop I know they've been around a long time and have definitely earned their good reputation. I've had 2 lifted Jeeps and my Tacoma aligned here always came out perfect service is quick and pricing is good.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text: Phenomenal service & work all around. I first went to them about 15 years ago for an alignment on my lowered Integra as they were one of the few places that could align lowered cars at the time. I recently bought a new car & was going to go to a different place that was closer but a friend recommended them & since I already had a good experience, I went & I'm glad. Just a real good shop

reviews.author: Wonjin Kim
reviews.text: Navigating the pothole-ridden roads and poor infrastructure of NJ and NYC can really take a toll on your car (in addition to the ridiculous GW Bridge toll). Luckily, I discovered an exceptional auto mechanic shop that has specialized in vehicle suspensions and alignments since 1964! When I called for a wheel alignment appointment, they estimated it would take just an hour. Upon arrival, I was impressed to see a bustling shop filled with all the commercial cars, trucks, and even buses of the region, the true road warriors. My car was ready in exactly one hour, including a highway road test, as promised. Afterward, I drove on a 1,100-mile road trip, and my car drove perfectly straight the entire way!

reviews.author: Vic Spinelli
reviews.text: They were knowledgeable and helpful in finding the cause of a problem I was having with a newly installed front-end systm on a Jeep Wrangler that had been done at another shop. THey were the first I thought of to get some squeaks and squeals taken care of on my motorhome. They found the problems and took care of it. I am very happy with their service and would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: David A. Martinez
reviews.text: Good old school Bergen County garage still going strong. Brian the manager is a very nice and honest guy. He definitely goes out of his way to make the customer happy. My only fault was the job they did was supposed to be done the same day. It ended up taking a day and a half. It wasn't totally their fault since on of the parts they were installing didn't want to cooperate. Overall I was totally satisfied with the finished product. Don't let the outside fool you, they do more than truck lifts. They do classics and modern car suspensions.

reviews.author: Edin Bilali
reviews.text: They diagnosed an issue with my car, I had no idea I cracked my rim on a speed bump during a winter storm, but they diagnosed it, didn’t charge me a penny, and made sure the dealer didn’t rip me off. Honest and trustworthy, I am in their debt, and I plan on getting my alignment done with them.

reviews.author: James Gaffney
reviews.text: I brought my wife's 2009 Highlander here. It has 198,000 miles. It sounded like it was falling apart. It made horrible clunking noises. It also rattled like a jaloppy. 6 hrs later Brian called and said it was ready. I'm telling you that this vehicle is now as quiet as my 2023 Jeep G.C. L. 4 new struts, a front axil and a much needed wheel alignment. FANTASTIC JOB Hackensak Auto Spring & wheel alignment. Thank you!

reviews.author: Kriztian Bgood
reviews.text: Just got my alignment done here on my lowered BMW after being told by big-name companies that it wasn’t possible, loved the atmosphere and was greeted by multiple people. Also better priced than most big-name companies. I made an appointment a day in advanced and was out in an hour, thank you Hackensack Auto Spring

reviews.author: Clara L
reviews.text: These guys are worth their weight in GOLD! Good Guys you can trust! They are the real deal. Don’t waste your time going anywhere else. They are true artist at their craft. They do a stellar job. They even take the time to go over everything with you. I have a 3500 dually that no one could align and these guys got me in and out. They don’t make people like this anymore. This is a solid business built by generations doing things honest and right.

reviews.author: Amanda K
reviews.text: Had one of the best experiences here. Being a female, its hard to get an honest diagnosis on my car. I came in for an alignment because my car was acting funny. They checked it out for me, called me with the diagnosis. I couldn't afford it that day, but I did pay a diagnostic fee of only $40! Came back a week later and they got the job done that same day. They even deducted the diagnostic fee off of my final bill that was already a reasonable price. I am so thankful! Thank you guys. Highly recommend this place if you are looking for honest service.

reviews.author: Foster A
reviews.text: The best place to go in town for any suspension or alignment problem. I went in this morning and was greeted by a young lady by the name of Victoria at the front desk, who was full of life and energy and very professional. She made my transition smooth and the job was done within 25mins. My car is no longer pulling to the left and my Wednesday morning is off to great start. Thanks you guys . Truly Appreciate the service

reviews.author: Brian Camacho
reviews.text: Needed no appointment. Came in for an alignment. Front desk receptionist was helpful and nice. I have seen other shops work differently when aligning my vehicle. I was confused on the fact that they took my car out from the shop for a couple of test drive to see if the car was running fine. After about an hour wait I got my car back and they charged me $70. They said nothing else. I since then sold the car I took to get an alignment but I honestly was not convinced on the work they performed.

reviews.author: kim robinson
reviews.text: I thought my experience here was going to be a good one until I paid my bill in full and I was given a crappy receipt. It's so bad my advisor asked for a better copy of it. I called Hackensack Auto Springs & Wheel and asked could I please get a better copy and the receptionist was snappy and said " I could try and make it neater but it's going to be the same thing". Totally shocked because I was a good customer. Not going back.

Bryan and his Techs know their stuff Will definitely recommend to others and be back myself when needed

reviews.text: Came here for the first time and got my car back the same day, excellent service and fair prices. The staff was welcoming and honest. Will definitely be coming back and referring to friends/family

reviews.author: Brandon Vega
reviews.text: I've been coming here for a few years now and have been nothing but satisfied with their work. Brian the owner is honest and fair, and his staff knows their stuff. Not every shop can correctly install suspension parts. I hear horror stories about a Mavis or one of those chain shops making cars worse than they went in. There is a reason why Hackensack springs have been around for over 50 years, and it is because they are the best around.

reviews.author: Lance Baresic
reviews.text: While the place has great customer service and it seems as though the guys there know their stuff, unfortunately I got the one who really didn't want to put the effort in to get my alignment right. Instead, he wanted to rush the job so he can relax before the whistle. I brought my TTB F-150 in because I got my alignment during the last winter when my bed was filled with snow (too cold to melt and no room to dump it). So, when I finally got the time to do an alignment, it was towards the end of summer so for a while, I was driving with the wheel cocked to the right. When I left, the truck was pulling a hair to the right and the transition from turning to straight ahead was a little hairy. Given that my mileage was good, I figure toe was good. I also noted that the tires tilted the wrong way when turned, which indicated the wrong caster angle. I brought it back explaining these issues and to fix it, they decided to just grease the ball joint but left the angles alone. More troubling, the alignment bushing they replaced they never fully seated (prongs on the bushing wasn't down in the hole far enough to engage the prongs on the axle). So, the person that did my alignment essentially just gave me a toe-n-go alignment. More troubling, the alignment bushing wasn't installed correctly so the bushing could spin in the hole (and has). That and when I looked at the bushing they did not replace (I put adjustable ones in when I rebuilt my front end and they used a fixed one) at my next tire rotation, I wasn't shocked to see the bushing set to almost max negative caster (hence the tire tilting incorrectly). So when you go here, I would recommend asking for anyone but Dave. There was no reason why he was done in 20 minutes and absolutely inexcusable that it wasn't fixed at my second visit or the fact the alignment bushing wasn't installed correctly (thank God it didn't spin on me on the highway). Shame as I've heard nothing but good from people about this place but due to this one person, I will probably never go again.

reviews.author: Jason A. Rodriguez
reviews.text: These guys know their stuff! I brought my jeep here for the famous #DeathWobble The moment they looked under my Jeep they knew what was causing the shaking, rattling and rolling. Yes, it took 4 hours. But they got it done and I got to see what they were doing. Great team! And the front desk girl is a sweetheart...Thank you Hackensack Auto Spring.

reviews.author: Jeffrey K
reviews.text: Great service, if you need an alignment, springs, struts, brakes, or anything to do with the frame of your vehicle, there is nowhere better than Hackensack Auto Spring. Oh did I mention they are very honest about the repairs as well.

reviews.author: The One
reviews.text: Great place for lowered cars that are slammed and for lifted vehicles. It's not like your local Pep Boys they're alignment rack is built on the ground and there was someone below ground that will do the work as needed so gives a true alignment with no problems

reviews.author: DAVE FROM JERSEY
reviews.text: They did a great Job on my Alignment. Drives perfectly straight. Steering wheel dead centered perfect. They've been here forever. I use them for all my Alignment work.

reviews.author: Robert McLaughlin
reviews.text: Went here for a wheel alignment on my lifted pickup where custom alignment specs are required. I handed them to the guy and he said "You don't want me to actually use these" and he laughed. I explained to him that these are the specs that are required and he said I already know the specs. He proceeded to do the alignment on a machine from the 1900's and used a Antiquated scuff gauge to set the toe. He was done in 15 mins and said You're all set. I paid and left. On my way home I hit a pothole and heard a loud clunk and my truck started pulling to the right. I get out and look and the wheel was crooked. I get home and crawl under the truck and found the cam bolt was not seated correctly and it was loose. So there goes $80 down the drain. I refuse to take let them touch my truck a 2nd time. I ended up going somewhere else and paid for a second alignment that was done correctly on a state-of-the-art alignment machine using the custom specifications I provided. I will never go back to that place again.

reviews.text: Came in today off a recommendation and was very pleased with how Bryan helped me, I work at a dealership myself so from my experience this guy really knows his stuff, very honest which is hard to find now a days especially as a first time customer.I will defiantly be sure to use him again. thanks for your help
